title: Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) for Triage D-dimer test kit supplies for FCRHC Laboratory
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF
description_text: **THIS IS AN INDIAN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS ECONOMIC ENTERPRISE (ISBEE) SET-ASIDE** The Indian Health Center, Four Corners Regional Health Center located at JCT US Highway 160 & Navajo Route 35 Red Mesa, AZ 86514 has a requirement for miscellaneous Triage D-dimer test kit supplies. The Blanket Purchase Agreement will be issued with a base year plus four (4) option years. The Government shall keep the solicitation posted and open for quotes until Monday 05/11/2026 @ 12:00pm MST. To be considered for award, your offer shall include the following documents/information listed in the attached Solicitation with subject line "75H7126Q00144".
